notes_for_owner: Added in the family plan's Phase 5. The catalog entry is written from formMCP's README and tauri.conf.json (identifier ai.nodemode.formmcp, owner's Q5). formMCP is a Cargo workspace like formtray, so its bundles are under target/release/bundle at the repository root; build_app and build_app.bat follow formtray's. The installed program is its own MCP launcher (formmcp mcp, no window), but no mcp_launch is set: the command differs per platform inside the bundle, the same open point as every app's (family plan, Q9). formMCP leaves itself out of its own family list. Linux installs libdbus-1-dev, which the core's keyring (secret-service) links and formmcp_oc_install checks for, as formMCP's own CI does. build_app makes the macOS disk image with hdiutil; formcompiler signs and notarizes it after the build (v0.6.0).
